title: Geometric certificate of a supplied canonical open cocone
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $W\subseteq O\subseteq X$ opens, with $W$ quasi-compact [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{op}\to Sch$ a diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transitions, with limiting cone $c$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Give a coherent system of abelian etale sheaves $F_i,\varphi_f$, a diagram $G_i\cong(c.\pi_i)^*F_i$ with the canonical arrow formula, and a colimit cocone $L$ of $G$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Fix $i_0$ and $e:D_{i_0}\cong O.toScheme$. Set $g_0=e;O.\iota$. With the opens, cohomology transitions $m_f$, and canonical legs $\kappa_j$ explicitly defined in [lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-open-cohomology-cocone], suppose $K:I_{\ge i_0}\to Ab$, $eK_j:K_j\cong H^0(W_j,F_j|_{W_j})$, and a cocone transformation $\iota:K\to const(H^0(W_L,L.pt|_{W_L}))$ satisfy $K(f)=eK_j;m_f;eK_k^{-1}$ and $\iota_j=eK_j;\kappa_j$. For any predicate $P$ on schemes with $P(W.toScheme)$, the canonical map $colim(K)\to H^0(W_L,L.pt|_{W_L})$ induced by this SUPPLIED cocone has a stage-cohomology comparison certificate for $P$ [def-weil-pbc-stage-cohomology-comparison]. No diagram, restriction transformation, or cocone is constructed in the conclusion; no isomorphism or injectivity is asserted.

source.place: Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), restriction of coherent systems to inverse-image opens; cohomology functoriality as in Tag 01F7.

proof.text: Explicitly construct the upper-tail functor into Over(op i0) and prove it initial. Apply isLimitOpensCone and reindex it along that functor. Compactness follows from the stage isomorphism to W and affine preimages. Quasi-separatedness follows from the open-subspace criterion, and affine transitions from the opensDiagram instance. The least-stage isomorphism is isoOfEq followed by preimageIso and isoOfLE.

Construct the restricted stage sheaves and coefficient maps using openSquareCoefficient, and the canonical limit coefficient isomorphisms using upperStarComp. Apply the restricted-system coherence theorem. Prove the upper-tail inclusion final by directedness, then apply final reindexing and preservation of colimits by upperStar to the supplied colimit L.

Apply StageCohomologyComparison.system to the explicit restricted system and its least-stage isomorphism to W. Unfold tailOpenCohomologyMap to derive its arrow equation from hK. Use the restricted-system canonical leg equation and hι for its cocone equation, and the explicit preserved sheaf colimit. No separate certificate theorem is assumed.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09YQ; explicit open-limit geometry and colimit preservation, reduced to coefficient coherence.

from.place: Restriction of coherent inverse systems to inverse-image opens in the single-open part of the degree-zero restriction row; realize the restricted open system and apply its comparison certificate (parent proof steps 1-3).

theorem etale_limit_open_comparison_certificate
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (O W : X.Opens) (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X)) (hWO : W ≤ O)
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L)
    (i₀ : I) (e : D.obj (op i₀) ≅ O.toScheme)
    (allowed : Scheme.{u} → Prop) (hallowed : allowed W.toScheme)
    (K : Set.Ici i₀ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eK : ∀ j : Set.Ici i₀, K.obj j ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (tailStageOpen D (e.hom ≫ O.ι) W j).ι).obj (F j.val)) 0))
    (hK : ∀ (j k : Set.Ici i₀) (f : j ⟶ k), K.map f =
      (eK j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyMap D (e.hom ≫ O.ι) W F φ f ≫ (eK k).inv)
    (ι : K ⟶ (Functor.const (Set.Ici i₀)).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ (e.hom ≫ O.ι)) ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj L.pt) 0)))
    (hι : ∀ j, ι.app j =
      (eK j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyLeg D c (e.hom ≫ O.ι) W F G eG L j) :
    StageCohomologyComparison allowed (colimit.desc K (Cocone.mk _ ι))
